3/5:  The RFI is being amended to incorporate the responses to vendor questions in Attachment 01 - Q&A Log - No Surprises Act - Responses to Vendor Questions.  The response date for the RFI remains unchanged and are due on March 17, 2026 at 2:00PM EST.  

The U.S. Department of Labor, Employee Benefit Security Administration (EBSA), seeks information/solutions for No Surprises Act (NSA) Services in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). This is a Request for Information (RFI). Please submit questions using Attachment 01 - QA Log NLT February 26, 2026. Responses to the RFI are due on March 17, 2026 at 2:00PM EST.
